title: Brustle
summary: BRUS'TLE, verb intransitive brus'l. To crackle; to make a small crackling noise; to rustle, as a silk garment; to vapor, as a bully.

inlines.v: BRUS'TLE, verb intransitive brus'l. To crackle; to make a small crackling noise; to rustle, as a silk garment; to vapor, as a bully.
